name: s0_reasoning_suppression
caption: For each generator, several candidate ways of switching reasoning off are attempted and the resulting reasoning-token count, visible output length and max_tokens compliance recorded. Reasoning tokens are disqualifying here: the block appended to the window would be only the visible part of what the model generated, max_tokens would stop bounding the block, and the reasoning text is meta-commentary rather than free continuation.
